TIDY UP YOUR WELCOMING SPACE: Keep your pet’s collar or leash at arm’s length, so reaching for your essential needs is no longer a hassle and creating DIY organization is fun.

description: A WALL HOOK THAT CAN ORGANIZE, DECORATE AND DO SO MUCH MORE WITH YOUR CREATIVITY…

There are endless opportunities when it comes to organization and utilizing your wall space efficiently. This wall hook can be utilized as a coat rack in the entryway, as a towel rack , bathrobe holder in the bathroom or as a pot and pan rack in the kitchen. This rustic wall hook is great for adding the perfect simplistic yet chic touch to your space.

If looking through Pinterest is your hobby, then experimenting with new decor will be your way of destressing. You can hang this rustic hook on a piece of wood to accentuate your design a little more. Hanging planters, lanterns and so much more will be a whimsical alternative to your everyday organization methods. To utilize this in your nursery you can create a beautiful decoupage with patterns and pictures and install this wall hook over your fun decor.

Revamp your entryway, mudroom, garage or office decoration and keep your coat, bag, umbrella close at hand. Customize your organization and take it to the next level by mounting more than one hook and adding labels to each plate. Visualize a decor that is unique to your home and mount a wall shelf over this wall hook. If you install more than one hook, you will have a custom wall unit that will fit your space and the bill perfectly.
UNIQUE, FUNCTIONAL, DECORATIVE, ORGANIZATIONAL, SPACIOUS AND AFFORDABLE design options, ALL AT YOUR FINGERTIPS!
